Hi Sarah — great to meet you on the call yesterday. Per our discussion, GreenGrid is scoped for a single production tenant with two test projects (dev & staging) to begin. I’m looping in Marissa (Customer Success/Implementation) and Karthik (Solutions Eng) to run the onboarding and the initial access setup.

Quick asks so Marissa can start provisioning:
- Confirm preferred primary contact for admin invites (name + email).
- Confirm network egress IP allowlist window (we can provide a short-lived range if you need it).
- Will you use your own KMS for key management or Redwood-managed keys?

We’d like to schedule a 60-minute kickoff this week to provision the tenant, create the projects, and exchange API key procedures. Suggested slots: Thu 7/9 10:00–11:00 PT or 2:00–3:00 PT.

Thanks — I’ll hand off to Marissa to outline the checklist.

— Vivek

Thanks Vivek — hi Sarah, excited to work with you. Below is the implementation starter checklist I’ll use during the kickoff. I attached the onboarding template and a sample allowlist file for your network/security team.

Implementation starter checklist (draft):
1) Tenant & projects
   - Create production tenant ID (provisioned by Redwood).
   - Create projects: prod, staging, dev — map teams and owners.
2) Admins & roles
   - Invite: One tenant admin (full control), two project admins (prod & staging).
   - Roles we typically provision: Tenant Admin, Project Admin, Developer (api access), Read-only Audit.
3) API keys & secrets
   - Decide: per-project API keys or shared key pattern. We recommend per-project keys for isolation.
   - Key rotation window and who will own rotation (GreenGrid security or Redwood-managed).
4) Networking & security
   - Provide egress IP allowlist (sample attached).
   - If using private deployment/VPC, provide VPC config and peering contacts.
5) Audit & observability
   - Set SSO (optional) or SAML metadata if you prefer SSO onboarding.
   - Logging & retention: confirm 30/90/365-day retention preference.
6) Test plan & success criteria
   - Smoke test: auth, request/response, latency under 500ms for 95th pct.
   - Acceptance: one-week validation window post-provisioning.

Please reply inline with the three quick answers Vivek requested (primary admin contact, allowlist window, KMS choice) and tell us which kickoff slot works. If you need a different template state (more compliance docs or an SOC2 evidence request), flag that and Karthik will prep the checklist.

Attachments: greengrid-tenant_onboarding_template.xlsx, greengrid_network_allowlist.txt

Best —
Marissa Cole
Customer Success Manager | Redwood Inference
marissa_cole@redwood.ai

Regards,
